title.zh: Singapore Gulf Bank Launches Stablecoin Conversion Services for Retail Banking C
title.en: Singapore Gulf Bank Launches Stablecoin Conversion Services for Retail Banking C

current_state.zh: Singapore Gulf Bank launched 24/5 in-app retail conversion between USD and USDT/USDC, letting customers hold stablecoins and fiat in the same bank account without using a crypto exchange.
current_state.en: Singapore Gulf Bank launched 24/5 in-app retail conversion between USD and USDT/USDC, letting customers hold stablecoins and fiat in the same bank account without using a crypto exchange.
